correctness.rationale: For each of the 10! permutations of exponents 1,...,10 assigned to bases 1,...,10, integer residues i^{sigma(i)} mod 10 determine a 10-bit support mask. The source proves a finite injection-state recurrence D_i(J,R); an independently written exhaustive lexicographic C++ loop enumerated all 3,628,800 permutations and reproduced histogram [K=5:9792,K=6:537408,K=7:1822464,K=8:1175040,K=9:84096], zero outside these K, including no K=10 and exact 84096/3628800=73/3150. The exhaustive finite domain is the entire claim, with no extrapolation.
residual_risks: No conclusion claimed for moduli other than ten or limiting random-permutation behavior.

value.rationale: Modulus 10 is the first even 2p case where p prime but p-1 squareful, precisely a natural boundary of the complete power-permutation criterion. The exact collision spectrum measures HOW non-nice it is, including the sharp frequency of nine residues. A full finite classification of this first arithmetic obstruction is intrinsically motivated, though narrow; it asserts no general congruence family.
